name: agents
title_zh: 给 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI
tagline_zh: 同一套编码规范要在两个 CLI 里各写一遍，改一处忘一处；这里把标准与可复用技能抽成一份，两边同时读。
tagline_en: Stop rewriting the same coding standards for every agent CLI. One shared set of rules and reusable skills that.
desc_en: Shared standards and reusable skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and other AI coding agents.
why_zh: 标准与技能分离存放，不绑定单一 CLI；新增一个 agent 只需接上目录，而不是把规矩再抄一遍。
why_en: Standards and skills live apart from any one CLI, so adding a new agent means pointing it at the folder, not copying your rules.
limit_zh: 它是规范与技能的集合，不含可直接跑的成品工具；只覆盖 Claude Code。
limit_en: A collection of standards and skills, not runnable tools. Only fits local-file agents like Claude Code and Codex CLI; web-only chats can't use it.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One shared rulebook and skill library for Claude Code and.
